title: Make the keys: one release signing identity, and the update key in the Studio keychain

before.command: manual: run on the Studio; generate_keys -p prints the public key
before.done_when: the Studio keychain holds the update key; the script prints the public key and the one gh secret set command Jordan runs for the signing identity

done_when: the Studio keychain holds the update key; the script exports it to a file for G-1's backup, re-imports that export into a scratch keychain and signs a test file with it, prints the public key, and exits non-zero if the two public keys differ; it prints the one gh secret set command Jordan runs for the signing identity
body: The private keys never pass through chat or a file in the repo.
